roles.background: analytic number theory; zeta/Li criteria; explicit formulas
roles.delegation: bind the candidate only to Coffey's exact prime/Laguerre coordinate and root contract
roles.finding: The immediate discriminator is not a new PNT estimate: first determine what Q_n plus an exact complement certificate says about the root-sensitive one-sided endpoint coordinate.
roles.strongest_objection: Do not call one-sided endpoint control Li positivity or RH; archimedean bookkeeping/all-index Li implications remain separate.

roles.background: orthogonal polynomials, asymptotic estimates, PNT error terms
roles.delegation: check whether R5/Bellotti input is actually needed now
roles.finding: R5 shows a complement can be made tiny only for a particular enormous external cutoff; no new internal-cut estimate is needed to test the obligation-strength algebra.
roles.strongest_objection: Importing the R5 tail to arbitrary Y_n would be an invalid transfer.

roles.finding: R_n(Y)>=-Q_n(Y) and S_n>=R_n(Y)-D_n(Y) imply S_n>=-Q_n(Y)-D_n(Y), hence (-S_n)_+<=Q_n(Y)+D_n(Y).
roles.strongest_objection: The implication is sufficient-control only and does not prove equivalence or target-domain nonimplication.
roles.recommendation: materialize effective-endpoint dichotomy if current gates pass

roles.background: counterexample-first proof auditing and quantifier stress testing
roles.delegation: attack the interpretation that strict cutoff automatically means weaker obligation
roles.finding: If D_n(Y_n) is certified negligible on the decision scale, the strict cut ceases to protect weakness: Q_n still upper-bounds the negative part of the near-endpoint value and therefore controls terminal downside up to D_n.
roles.strongest_objection: A target-domain hostile pair could still exist for a different non-extremal statistic; do not generalize family closure beyond running negative excursions.
roles.recommendation: close only the Q_n running-excursion family

roles.background: conditional convergence, Abel/summation-by-parts, local-to-global proof gluing
roles.delegation: separate local inequality from global/source-order legality
roles.finding: No rearrangement is used: R_n(Y) is a finite natural-order prefix and D_n(Y) is the exact natural-order complement. If D is not proved, the gluing failure remains exactly where R7 left it.
roles.strongest_objection: An alternative summation convention or independently regrouped infinite window would invalidate the target identity.
roles.recommendation: record current summation-compatibility surface as routing/gluing-only

roles.background: RAKL v3 authority, TaskEpisode, failure lattice, metrology
roles.delegation: apply current framework changes prospectively and audit action routing
roles.finding: Current v3 realization-domain typing exactly catches the R7 overreach risk: its hostile path is AMBIENT_REPRESENTATION -> REPRESENTATION_ONLY. Current framework candidate-freeze revalidation must run immediately before materialization.
roles.strongest_objection: Do not back-credit R7 as current-v3 compliant or treat proposal Class-B gates as theorem authority.
roles.recommendation: GLUE R7+R6 under current gate; no framework issue needed

roles.background: formal statement binding, dependency audits, prior-art/novelty separation
roles.finding: The elementary inequality can be checked directly, but it is not a new RH theorem and no literature-novelty claim is defensible without a dedicated search.
roles.strongest_objection: Do not count same-context agreement as independent review and do not count the proposal lesson as validated learning.

disagreements: The domain lead views the implication as useful route pruning; the adversarial lead insists it closes only the running-excursion family, not all strict-cut statistics.
The PNT lead sees possible downstream value in estimating D_n(Y), but the v3/metrology lead recommends deferring it until the strength discriminator is recorded.
strongest_shared_objection: A small complement plus Q_n control may reconstruct the root-sensitive endpoint downside; proving the complement first could therefore spend major effort without producing a weaker obligation.
unresolved_uncertainties: Whether any target-domain arithmetic DifferenceWitness exists for a different non-extremal internal statistic.
Whether a one-sided endpoint lower-control theorem of the exact needed strength can be obtained without becoming RH-equivalent through the rest of the Li ledger.
recommendation: Proceed only with the elementary effective-endpoint obligation-strength candidate after current-framework freeze revalidation; do not attempt a new PNT/zero-free estimate in this cycle.
